paragraphs.text: DSH Desktop plugin: usage stats, plan quotas, custom HTTPS balance, 26-week heatmap
# dsh-usage-plus
中文 | English
Independent DSH usage and official Plan-quota plugin (Host + Web UI). It does not pin a DSH version:
optional UI surfaces activate only when the running DSH exposes the required capabilities.

- Reuses credentials already configured for DSH model providers.
- Shows real 5-hour, weekly, and mo

nthly windows on `conversation.composer.dock` (alongside StatsPills / ContextMeter).
- Labels every
Plugins-page number with its scope (`全设备` / `账号级` / `本会话`) so device-wide totals never read as sessi

on totals.
- Renders nothing when a provider exposes no official quota window.
- Keeps CPAMC and Vol

cano Ark as separate sources (Plugins page → Settings).
- Overview includes a full 26-week Mon–Sun a

ctivity heatmap (ledger default 182 days).
- Keeps all secrets in the host process / credential vaul

t.
- Shares one conditional-GET poller across the Plugins page and every composer strip; requests ne

ver overlap and a hidden tab pauses.
- Serves the overview from a per-revision host cache, so warm p
olls skip ledger aggregation and answer `304` from a cached ETag.
## Screenshots
### Composer plan strip (current model)
When the active model matches an official plan source, the composer dock shows a compact pill with t
he real 5-hour / weekly / monthly readings; the ring marks the tightest window. Open it for per-wind
ow bars, reset times, and the source chip (for example Volcano). Nothing is rendered when the remote
API exposes no official window.
### Plugins → Usage · Overview
The overview reads as one instrument panel: a hero figure for today, the 26-week heatmap as the main
chart, account-level quota rings, and a 30-day provider ranking. Every figure is labelled with its
scope (`全设备` / `账号级`); the balance line only lists real balances. Plan quotas and external sources l
ive on the other tabs of the same Plugins page.
## Install
Install into a DSH profile with the official plugin command (adds the dependency and appends the pac
kage to `dsh.profile.bundles` so `cordis.patch.yml` is applied):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The GitHub form installs the committed `lib/` artifacts in this repository. The npm package may lag
behind the GitHub release, so prefer the GitHub form when you want the current version.

The package ships its own bundle patch (`id: usage-plus`, `name: dsh-usage-plus`).
If the older `@li

nxin666/dsh-usage` / `web-ui-usage` row is also present, disable it
in the profile patch to avoid du

-usage` / `web-ui-usage` row is also present, disable it
in the profile patch to avoid duplicate UI.
Optional credential names are `CPAMC_MANAGEMENT_KEY`, `VOLC_ACCESSKEY`, and `VOLC_SECRETKEY`. Enable
the matching source under **Plugins → Usage Statistics → Settings**, then **Save**. Leaving the pag
e discards an unsaved draft (official `plugins.item` contract).
## Model Experience
- Quota strip follows the **session** `modelSelection` projection (composer picker / `/model`). It d
oes not fall through to another session’s or the global plan while this session already has a route.
- Windows are only shown when the remote Plan API returns real percentages; there is no local token

estimate disguised as quota.
- Token ledger and balance cards stay on the Plugins page; they do not
inject into the conversation transcript.
## Known Limitations
- DSH versions are not pinned. Missing optional surfaces (`configForms`, `plugins.item`, `conversati

on.composer.dock`) are treated as unavailable capabilities instead of a startup failure.
- Providers

without an official Plan API show no strip and no fabricated windows.
- CPAMC accepts loopback orig
ins (or hosts listed in `cpamcAllowedHosts`) only; management routes are read-only and reject redire

cts.
- Volcano Ark needs vaulted AK/SK (or `VOLC_ACCESSKEY` / `VOLC_SECRETKEY`); signing runs only i

n the Host process.
- Floating pet bubble announcements need a separate pet service in the profile;
`bubbleMode: off` disables them.
## Performance
- **One shared poll loop.** The Plugins page and every composer strip share one in-flight overview r
ead; burst triggers collapse into a trailing request, a manual refresh queues behind a read, and a h

idden document pauses polling.
- **Cached host overview.** The host rebuilds the overview at most on
ce per data revision. Warm reads answer `304 Not Modified` from a cached ETag without re-aggregating
the retained ledger (measured warm overhead ≈0.02 ms vs ≈5 ms before on a 182-day / 2-provider × 3-

model ledger; cold assembly is unchanged).
- **One-pass aggregation.** The 26-week heatmap is built
from one precomputed per-day table, and the all-time window skips the per-model rows the page never
precomputed per-day table, and the all-time window skips the per-model rows the page never renders.
## Development
`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` cover the plugin. To review the Web UI without the a
uthenticated DSH Web GUI, run `python scripts/preview/shot.py` and inspect the PNGs under `docs/scre
enshots/`; see scripts/preview/README.md.
## Accuracy
Plan UI and the composer strip only display windows returned by official remote APIs. Missing Plan A
PI, missing percentages, or probe failures are never replaced with local estimates.
## License
Based on `@linxin666/dsh-usage` (Apache-2.0). CPAMC security constraints and Volcano signing behavio
r reference `dsh-cost-meter` (MIT). See LICENSE.
